title: SENARA Student OS
tagline: A personal operating system for university life — academic tracking, task management, goals, and a full Google Drive filing system — built into one Google Sheet.
problem: University coursework, semester deadlines, syllabi, and grade documents are scattered across disparate messaging groups and personal drives, making longitudinal academic progress difficult to monitor.
solution: A centralized academic command center featuring GPA target simulators, milestone trackers, and automated Google Drive folder provisioning linked directly to semester course records.
results: Automated & idempotent Google Drive folder provisioning created dynamically per course and semester
Coursework indexing system that links submission documents directly to their corresponding task records
Four-year academic schema engineered to organize long-term coursework and transcript histories in a single system
GPA target simulator providing real-time projections and academic standing visibility
